sampling: All three projects bearing the combined top-overall award label, plus five purposively selected supplementary winners spanning beginner, accessibility, transport education, entertainment and finance awards. Supplementary records are not representative of all sponsor winners.
evidence_policy: Awards are verified from Devpost's Submitted to award labels. Features and implementation are team-reported, not independently tested. Yes means explicitly documented; unknown means not documented clearly, not absent. No is used only when explicitly excluded. Runtime AI is distinct from AI-assisted development. Hardware includes custom physical prototypes or explicitly listed VR devices, not ordinary laptops or phones.

event.prize_value_caveat: Advertised Devpost prize value, not verified cash paid; prize descriptions include physical goods, credits and other benefits.
event.gallery_count_caveat: 24 winner-labelled projects appear on page 1, five more at the beginning of page 2. This is an observed count from those two pages, not a independently verified exhaustive winner census.
event.ranking_note: The same combined award label appears on all three overall winners. Their individual first/second/third ranks are not established by these sources.
event.criteria_summary: The event asks judges to assess finish, novelty, appearance, implementation and ease of use. Its overall-prize description additionally emphasizes creativity, execution and impact.
event.submission_requirement: Attach a GitHub repository to the submission.
event.sponsor_context: Google Cloud requires ADK and/or A2A agent architecture; Google and Microsoft solicit AI for social benefit; Netflix asks for branching interactive entertainment; State Farm asks for insurance education; Capital One asks for emerging-technology finance applications. These prompts can influence observed winning-project themes.

current_edition.status_at_cutoff: Event has not completed as of 2026-09-25; excluded from historical winner analysis.
current_edition.evidence: INIT's official interest site gives September 25-27. MLH places ShellHacks under 2026 on those dates. FIU lists the tenth annual event beginning September 25, 2026.

projects.name: EcoSort
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section labels both awards as Winner.
projects.target_user_problem: Students and community members uncertain about correct recycling and donation.
projects.core_workflow: Photograph an item, receive disposal guidance, review scans and find donation or drop-off locations.

flag_evidence.ai_ml: AI-assisted development is described, but runtime classifier implementation is unspecified.
flag_evidence.external_api_service: Built and hosted on Base44; live application linked.
flag_evidence.accessibility_inclusion: No specific disability or inclusion mechanism documented.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Purpose is improved recycling and reduced waste.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: Scanner, learning, history and map pages described.

projects.limitations: Hardware and some mapping ambitions were deferred; effectiveness was not independently measured.

projects.name: FloodGuard
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section displays the combined overall Winner label.
projects.target_user_problem: Residents, emergency responders and city officials need earlier flood warnings.
projects.core_workflow: Parallel agents monitor weather, infrastructure and alerts, then coordinate risk notifications.

flag_evidence.ai_ml: Describes functioning multi-agent loop using ADK/A2A.
flag_evidence.external_api_service: Google Cloud deployment and API data flows specified.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Flood preparedness for communities is the stated purpose.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: Frontend demo plus console and agent-status screenshots listed.

projects.limitations: Direct city-system connections, SMS/push delivery and wider model training are future work; forecast accuracy is unverified.

projects.name: Lumi Lens
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section displays the combined overall Winner label.
projects.target_user_problem: Neurodivergent users navigating emotionally difficult social situations.
projects.core_workflow: An emotion input drives generated supportive dialogue and playful phone or glasses overlays.

flag_evidence.accessibility_inclusion: Designed to support neurodivergent social interaction.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Assistive support and reduced social stress are stated goals.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: Working camera overlay UI and simulation demo described.
flag_evidence.hardware: Prototype glasses, Raspberry Pi and display documented.

projects.limitations: Live emotion detection encountered blockers; the demo used simulation. User studies are future work, so benefit is an intended outcome.

projects.name: Happy Head
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section labels Best First-Time Hacker as Winner.
projects.target_user_problem: Coaches, athletes and medical staff may miss potentially harmful sporting impacts.
projects.core_workflow: Sense acceleration and rotation, trigger display/audio alerts and log events for web review.

flag_evidence.ai_ml: Camera component uses MediaPipe FaceMesh detection.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Athlete safety is the stated purpose.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: Website provides charts, tables and event filtering.
flag_evidence.hardware: Microcontroller, motion sensor, LCD and camera specified.

projects.limitations: A monitoring prototype, not a validated diagnostic device; wireless hardware and correlation with diagnosed concussions are future work.

projects.name: A11y Tools
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section labels Google Cloud as Winner.
projects.target_user_problem: People with mobility, visual or cognitive impairments face barriers on ordinary web pages.
projects.core_workflow: Choose extension tools for voice interaction, image description, text simplification, search or font changes.

flag_evidence.ai_ml: LLM interprets input and fills forms through an ADK loop.
flag_evidence.external_api_service: Gemini API and streamed audio integration documented.
flag_evidence.accessibility_inclusion: Five accessibility functions address stated impairments.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Broader access to web content is the purpose.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: Extension popup and main-UI screenshot described.

projects.limitations: Quota failures affected testing; Chrome speech fallback exists; search navigation remained incomplete.

projects.name: GreenLight
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section labels State Farm as Winner.
projects.target_user_problem: Drivers need actionable learning from unsafe driving incidents.
projects.core_workflow: Upload footage, analyze an incident, display a 3D reconstruction and answer tailored safety quizzes.

flag_evidence.ai_ml: Gemini analyzes footage and generates educational simulations.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Safer driving education is the stated purpose.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: Dashboard, 3D simulations and quizzes shown in screenshots.
flag_evidence.hardware: Live phone-dashcam feature was cut; prototype uses uploaded files.

projects.limitations: Real-time dashcam analysis was deferred; generated output reliability required prompt refinement. Safety effectiveness is not independently demonstrated.

projects.name: Quests and Conflicts VR
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section labels Netflix as Winner.
projects.target_user_problem: Players seeking branching, immersive tabletop-inspired entertainment.
projects.core_workflow: Interact with a VR narrative whose paths respond to player choices.

flag_evidence.external_api_service: Creation tools named, but no runtime external service established.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Entertainment is described; no public-benefit goal established.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: VR interaction MVP and game-scene screenshots documented.
flag_evidence.hardware: Quest 3 and Oculus VR device tags appear; not custom hardware.

projects.limitations: Team describes an MVP; store publication remained a future plan. This is a sponsor-winning entertainment workflow without documented runtime AI or a social-impact aim.

projects.name: Agent Zero
projects.award_evidence: Submitted to section labels Capital One as Winner.
projects.target_user_problem: Individuals and small businesses need help identifying suspicious invoices.
projects.core_workflow: Route invoice checks to specialized agents and aggregate risk scores into a readable assessment.

flag_evidence.ai_ml: Specialized agents assess invoice risks with trained models.
flag_evidence.external_api_service: Gemini and BigQuery are listed backend technologies.
flag_evidence.accessibility_inclusion: Aims to assist people unable to afford financial professionals.
flag_evidence.social_environmental_benefit: Financial-scam prevention and access are stated motivations.
flag_evidence.visual_demo_interface: React frontend and concise user-facing assessment described.

projects.limitations: Accuracy and speed improvement claims lack public evaluation numbers on this page; financial protection is an intended benefit.
